node.title: The unguarded joint-owner chart has the exact MDS support census
node.statement: Let P0 be the squarefree joint anchor locator of degree p and let the determinant coordinate H range over all polynomials of degree at most r. Exact joint-owner strata are exactly the zero-support strata of the length-p dimension-(r+1) Reed-Solomon evaluation code. For each fixed owner Q of degree q, their size is the printed MDS inclusion-exclusion count; in particular every degree-r divisor Q of P0 occurs with exactly |F|-1 chart points, so the complete top-owner ambient chart has binom(p,r)(|F|-1) points.
